title: Convergent telemetry gateway: latency stitcher for per-request KPI reconstruction
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Inference request telemetry arrives fragmented across proxies, sidecars, and GPU nodes (OTel spans, Prometheus counters, and custom inference KPI envelopes). With batching, KV cache hits, and model fallbacks, simple aggregation undercounts tail latency and obscures cold-starts and cache-miss behavior.

Goal: Build a convergent telemetry gateway that deterministically stitches traces and metric envelopes into per-request KPI records usable by downstream SLO/alerting and the latency/error dashboards. The gateway should support lossy environments (partial spans), tenant-scoped sampling, and smart replay to synthesize missing timings for batched or multiplexed requests.

Scope: Implement an OTLP ingestion layer plus a lightweight proto normalization/mapping that: (1) accepts OTel spans and Prometheus-derived KPI events, (2) computes best-effort per-request latency and error attribution, (3) emits canonical KPI envelopes to the metric bus and a compact trace link for debugging. This is an infra-level service intended for hosted and Dedicated nodes and must be resilient to reordering, duplicates, and transient backpressure.
comments: 2026-03-11: Spike complete — validated approach using deterministic request-id derivation from span tags and prefix hash. Prototype can reconstruct per-request latencies for 92% of sampled records in a replayed tracelog.

2026-03-12: Architecture review with Platform and Runtime teams. Feedback: ensure gateway can be configured with tenant sampling policies and that it emits privacy-safe identifiers when customer PII tags are present.

2026-03-12: Design note: use a two-phase reconcile (in-memory short window + compact on-disk journal) to handle late-arriving spans without unbounded state. We will leverage existing sidecar admission markers (see ENG-42111) for stronger linkage where present.
2026-03-13: PRD updated with acceptance criteria and rollout plan. Requesting security_review_required before e2e tests run in staging.
acceptance_criteria: Gateway ingests OTLP and Prometheus-derived KPI envelopes and emits a canonical per-request KPI envelope to the metric bus (schema v1) for >= 95% of non-sampled production traffic within a 5 second reconciliation window.

Latency stitching computes (client_send -> server_first_byte -> server_last_byte -> model_token_finish) components and attributes tail latencies to cache_miss/cache_hit/fallback buckets when evidence exists.
Service handles reordering and duplicates: duplicate envelopes must be deduped with >99.9% precision and reordering window defaults to 30s with configurable TTL per tenant.
Expose diagnostic trace-links (compact span IDs) to Console so engineers can pivot from KPI to raw spans; integration test that links are resolvable in staging dashboards.
Performance: handle sustained 20k req/s ingestion with 120s burst buffering without data loss in normal operating conditions (backpressure to upstream allowed).
Security: when PII tags or full-text fields are present, gateway must redact per policy and emit privacy-safe pseudo-ids. Security review approval recorded in ticket.
